checks.name: Independent price source (Coinbase)
checks.detail: Coinbase agreed on direction in 98.9% of 90 sampled windows and 100.0% of those that finished $2.00+ from the line (under $1.00: 23/24; $1.00–2.00: 16/16; $2.00–4.00: 22/22; $4.00+: 28/28). Disagreement near the line is expected: Coinbase is one exchange, the index averages several. 10 windows had no candles.

checks.name: Runs test (is the sequence random?)
checks.detail: 15,864 runs vs 15,232 expected (z = +7.24, p = 0.000): more switches than chance: results tend to alternate. Check that it also holds out of sample.

checks.name: Does one result predict the next?
checks.detail: lag-1 correlation -0.0415 (z = -7.25). Statistically non-zero, but check its size: a correlation this small moves the next window's odds by only about 2.1 percentage points, less than fees cost.

checks.name: Hour-of-day lean holds out of sample?
checks.detail: Split at 2026-05-25. Hours that looked significant in the first half: 18:00; still significant, same direction, in the second half: 18:00. Correlation of hourly leans between halves: +0.38 (some persistence; worth watching).

checks.name: Streak behaviour holds out of sample?
checks.detail: after 3 Ups the next was Up 43.8% (first half, n=1,599) vs 46.6% (second half, n=1,743); after 3 Downs the next was Up 57.0% (first half, n=1,623) vs 54.0% (second half, n=1,730). For a fade-or-follow rule to pay, the same lean must show in both halves and be larger than the ~2–3¢ per contract that spread and fees cost.

checks.name: Kalshi price edge holds out of sample?
checks.detail: No price level was clearly profitable after fees. 10 more showed a paper profit that sits inside its error band, so it could just be luck: buy Yes at 60–70¢: +8.7¢ ±14.8 (n=34); buy No at 40–50¢: +7.6¢ ±15.1 (n=40); buy No at 20–30¢: +5.1¢ ±10.8 (n=51). Most windows trade under 10¢ or over 90¢; there, recent results ran -0.6¢ to +0.2¢ per contract.

checks.name: Chance findings to expect
checks.detail: The report tests 35 hour, weekday and slot groups; at 95% confidence about 1.8 would look significant by luck alone. Found: 2. That's no more than luck would produce.
